paper.title: Online Learning for Function Placement in Serverless Computing

settings.name_in_paper: Virtual function placement (VFP) with stochastic costs and resource constraints
unmapped: Arms are N computation nodes; contexts are M i.i.d. function classes with unknown arrival distribution lambda

K resource types with known node capacities beta_{i,k}; random resource requirements A_{i,j,k} in [0,1] observed for all nodes before placement (full information on resource usage, bandit feedback on cost)
Learner chooses a randomized placement policy p (N x M stochastic matrix); constraint on expected resource load g_{i,k}(p, kappa) <= 1 must hold with high probability
A fictitious rejection node with infinite resources and cost 1 ensures feasibility
settings.definition_quote: R(T) = \sum_{t=1}^T  \mathbb{E}(f({\hat p}(t),c,\lambda) - f(p^\star,c,\lambda)) while respecting the constraints with high probability, that is \mathbb{P}( \max_{i,k} g_{i,k}({\hat p}(t),\kappa) \le 1) = 1 - o(1) when T \to \infty

bound.expression_latex: {R(T) \over T} \le {N M \over T} [ 2( \sqrt{2} + 1) \sqrt{T \ln T} +  6 K (1 + \ln T) ]

symbols.N_nodes: number of computation nodes (arms), including fictitious rejection node
symbols.M_ctx: number of function classes (contexts), paper's M

tuning: confidence level log t in KL confidence bounds

source.label: th:regret
source.quote: Under the proposed algorithm the constraints are satisfied with high probability and the regret per unit of time vanishes at the rate: {R(T) \over T} \le {N M \over T} [ 2( \sqrt{2} + 1) \sqrt{T \ln T} +  6 K (1 + \ln T) ] \underset{T \to \infty}{\sim} O( N M \sqrt{\ln T \over T } ) \mathbb{P} (\max_{i,k} g_{i,k}({\hat p}(t)) \le 1) \ge 1 - 6 N M K {\ln T \over T}

results.notes: Paper states bound on R(T)/T; multiplied by T. Regret defined via expected cost function f of the policy (pseudo-regret) against the optimal static feasible policy. Paper's K is resource types, N nodes, M classes; renamed. Holds for the base algorithm; the fast variant has no stated guarantee.

bound.expression_latex: \mathbb{P} (\max_{i,k} g_{i,k}({\hat p}(t)) \le 1) \ge 1 - 6 N M K {\ln T \over T}

conditions: costs and resource requirements in [0,1] i.i.d.

source.label: th:regret
source.quote: \mathbb{P} (\max_{i,k} g_{i,k}({\hat p}(t)) \le 1) \ge 1 - 6 N M K {\ln T \over T}\underset{T \to \infty}{\to} 1

results.notes: Bound on the probability of constraint violation by the chosen policy at time t (expression is the violation probability). The statement is ambiguous about t vs T; proof gives 6NMK/t per round.
